repos_data.description: Run Pine Script® anywhere. PineTS is LuxAlgo's open-source Pine Script® runtime for Node.js and the browser.

Open-source C++17 engine for backtesting and forward execution, with a versioned C ABI; Pine Script v6 runs through code generation. Against TradingView's own trade lists, all 7,989 graded probes (309 open-corpus strategies, 741 closed-test scripts) grade excellent or strong: 7,983 excellent, 6 strong. Apache-2.0.
Self-hosted market alerts (price, RSI, Pine Script v5) via push, email & Telegram — run TradingView-style alerts off-platform.
Dealer-gamma levels for TradingView - flip, call/put walls, 0DTE pinning - computed daily from real options data (NQ, DOW, Gold, DAX). Free yfinance + Eurex ODAX pipeline.
Know before you risk. Realtime Pine signal timing observed against bar-close state; no forecast.
